name: ECC
description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
one_liner: An add-on system that gives AI coding assistants like Claude Code a persistent memory and a set of learned habits, so they stop forgetting your project every time you start a new session.
buyer: An indie developer or small dev consultancy that's frustrated with re-explaining their codebase to their AI assistant every session.
business_use_cases: A solo developer keeps a persistent memory of project conventions and past decisions across every coding session, cutting repeated back-and-forth with the AI.
A dev consultancy configures a shared 'instincts and memory' profile for a client's codebase so every consultant's AI assistant behaves consistently.
A dev-tools company builds a paid dashboard on top of it for teams to manage and share their agent's memory and skill configuration.

money_ideas.idea: Sell premium, pre-tuned configuration packs for specific frameworks or codebases.
Offer paid setup consulting to dev teams who want it configured for their specific stack.

steal_this: Package a ready-made 'memory profile' for one popular framework (e.g. Next.js or Django) and sell it to indie developers who are tired of re-explaining their stack to their AI assistant — directly answers a common developer complaint.
